scope: Read-only diagnostic of stable raw prefixes through 117 years. Neither full 200-year simulation is complete. Validates common-window versus longer-window reporting; not a claim of completed runs or late-cycle convergence.

provenance.scientific_input: published equations and explicitly configured assumptions; no imported simulation state
published equations and explicitly configured assumptions; no imported simulation state

checks: Every first-100-year event exactly matches the earlier published raw-prefix audit.
Both raw prefixes contain consecutive finite accepted history rows, positive effective stress and accepted error estimates at most one.
Every catalogued rupture uses exact saved threshold-crossing profiles and connected 1 cm slip footprints.
The longer-window report helper includes later events while retaining the unchanged 100-year metrics.
When the common and full durations coincide, the helper does not duplicate the comparison.
report_helper_prose_for_truncated_test_i:
The time-tolerance comparison also includes every resolved rupture over the first 100 years. The baseline and tighter-tolerance cases contain 20 and 20 resolved ruptures, respectively, from 21 and 20 complete threshold excursions.
Across the 20 chronological pairs, the maximum absolute differences are 83.2 min in onset, 1.47\% in duration, 1.1\% in peak speed, and 0.0062\% in maximum slip.
All pairs have identical connected 1 cm rupture footprints on the saved depth grid and identical large-event classifications.
These measurements test time tolerance on the baseline mesh. Footprint comparisons are limited by the saved depth spacing, about 30 m in the scientific runs. They do not establish spatial convergence or recovery of the published swarm sequence.

The baseline and tighter-tolerance runs both extend beyond the common validation window. We therefore repeat the comparison over their full shared duration of 117 years, so agreement confined to the early cycles cannot substitute for assessment of later events.

helper_input_description: The reporting helper receives the two independently reread catalogs restricted to 117 years, with final_time_years=117, solely to verify comparison windows. The production calculations still target 200 years and continue running.
